observations: Photo 0 shows a used metal transmission casing with bell housing flange, mounting points, and casting marks; no readable brand or model.
Photo 1 shows the side/top of the transmission with a black attached component, wiring, and an unreadable sticker; general grime and use visible.
Photo 2 shows the clutch assembly (pressure plate, clutch disc, flywheel surface) inside the bell housing, confirming a manual transmission; visible surface rust.
All photos carry the watermark "U-ZION LINKS AUTO'S" and "POSTED ON JIJI".

risks.risk: Internal gears, bearings, and synchronizers may be worn or broken.
risks.proof: Video of shafts rotating freely and gear selection detents, or borescope inspection of internals.

risks.risk: Transmission may leak oil from seals or gaskets.
risks.proof: Close-up inspection of all mating surfaces, drain plug, and seals; or pressure/leak test.
risks.if_unproven: as leaking and needing seal replacement

risks.risk: Unit may be incomplete (missing mounts, sensors, linkages, or bell housing bolts).
risks.proof: Full inventory photo showing every included attachment and opening.
Readable part number, casting number, or nameplate matching a specific car model.

proof_requests: Clear close-up of any casting numbers, part number stickers, or manufacturer nameplates.
Video showing the input shaft turning and gears being selected through the shift mechanism.
Close-up photos of all external seals, gaskets, and mating surfaces for leaks.
Full shot showing all included mounts, sensors, linkages, and hardware.
response.reason: The item is identifiable as a used manual car transmission with clutch, but no brand, model, or working condition is proven, so it must be priced at its worst case as a non-working core.
